news.title: Ascension Parish Zoning Commission advises council to adopt changes for data center development

facts: Ascension Parish Zoning Commission voted to require any data center applicant to hold two public meetings before submitting a rezoning application for high impact development facilities
Commission voted to require data center operators to independently generate, operate and maintain power
Commission voted to lower the allowed data center decibel level from 50 to 45
Commission recommendations will go to the full parish council for an additional vote
